Within the combinatorial methodology of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the text examines conditional relations at the intersection of the *kusalattika* (the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states) and the *hetuhetusampayuttaduka* (the dyad of states that are roots and associated with roots) [SuttaCentral].
